name: Fat Suppression Required
description: Post-contrast orbit T1 imaging requires fat suppression for adequate optic nerve visualization and enhancement detection. (From the MS CMSC MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
# Check for fat suppression techniques
# Common indicators: ScanOptions contains 'FS' or 'FAT', or SequenceVariant contains 'SP' (spectral)
scan_options = value["ScanOptions"].iloc[0] if "ScanOptions" in value.columns and not pd.isna(value["ScanOptions"].iloc[0]) else ""
seq_variant = value["SequenceVariant"].iloc[0] if "SequenceVariant" in value.columns and not pd.isna(value["SequenceVariant"].iloc[0]) else ""

# Convert to string for checking
scan_options_str = str(scan_options).upper() if scan_options else ""
seq_variant_str = str(seq_variant).upper() if seq_variant else ""

has_fat_sat = any(fs in scan_options_str for fs in ['FS', 'FAT', 'SPIR', 'SPAIR', 'CHESS'])
has_spectral = 'SP' in seq_variant_str

if not has_fat_sat and not has_spectral:
    raise ValidationWarning("Orbit T1 imaging may lack fat suppression. Fat suppression is required for adequate optic nerve visualization.")
